content: Light pre-processing was performed on the corpus before training it. For example, invalid characters or characters other than Devanagari were removed but punctuation and numbers were not removed. We set the window context at 10 and the rare words whose count is below 5 are dropped. These word embeddings were not frozen during the training session because fine-tuning word embedding help achieve better performance compared to frozen oneBIBREF20.
